notes.title: Spitfire - Moonpies Mission Demo Update 1.03
notes.notes:
Spitfire - Moonpie’s Mission Demo 1.03 Update

Thank you for all the feedback you've given me on Twitch (rennsemmel81) to help with the development. :)

Once again, I've gathered your suggestions and implemented the most important points directly into the game. While many of these points mainly concern the main game, some have made their way into the demo as well.

These changes and the further development of the game are quite extensive, which would inevitably lead to significant spoilers. Therefore, I'll refrain from using images and will summarize the main points briefly. :)

There’s a new crosshair equipped with a heart in the center, which shows the player how much health they have left.
A dynamic energy indicator shows how many shots remain in the magazine and automatically refills once the magazine is emptied.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45299991/22259119a8eebf8070239d0f655c521446b4b8f7.png

Two new companions have been added:

One will help you move faster, and the other will surely make your life more difficult. :D
Another important feature is the skill and level reset function: In order to unlock certain achievements, you need to be able to reset your skills to 0 after completing the game.

Another feature involves the companions themselves: Once a companion is selected, it will be confirmed with a small green checkmark, making it clearer for the player that this companion is joining the journey.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45299991/4e0f4b4edf09a03090a13b4f95b534bb24046f6b.png

There are many more details that have been improved, but I don’t want to spoil too much here. Various bugs have also been fixed, such as the sunflower enemies in the first level that would interrupt their animation when hit. They now continue their animation even when they take damage. Several sound, animation, and design bugs have been addressed as well.

I will of course continue working on the main game and transfer these changes to the demo. It’s especially important to me to keep working closely with you all to create a great gaming experience.

That’s why I’ll also be including the wonderful community in the credits – of course, only with your consent and at your request.

Best regards,
rennsemmel81

notes.title: Spitfire - Moonpies Mission Demo Update 1.02
notes.notes:
Spitfire - Moonpie’s Mission Demo 1.02 Update

Thank you for all the feedback you've given me on Twitch (rennsemmel81) for the development. :)

Once again, I’ve compiled your suggestions and directly implemented the most important points into the game. Many of the suggestions were primarily related to the main game, but some of them have also made it directly into the demo.

Here’s a little insight into the changes I’ve made:

All upgradable abilities now have proper names and descriptions (previously, there was only placeholder text).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45299991/54b924dac23fd91d6b21dd22f4432bba8e2110a0.png


All the animals that you can rescue and unlock as supporters now also have names and descriptions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45299991/fa9e865af43260a400d37d4ef57218cb90111a66.png


A small, bouncing gold icon has been added behind all costs in the menu. Previously, the costs were difficult to understand.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45299991/35397f31c5f031eaeab8b36d08387c76f5e01d89.png


In the first stage, the hidden bats in the dark were previously seen more as background design and were sometimes hard to perceive. Now, they blink continuously, and once you’ve transformed the first vine, all the bats appear fully, making them much easier to spot and interact with.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45299991/a02785cd776a1589c59081fa87e161a6d2049fa3.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45299991/14c8f6e921e7cdda1cd34f1fd2d9e9bd616dbe5a.png

I will, of course, continue working on the main game and also transfer these changes to the demo. It's still very important to me to maintain close collaboration with all of you in order to create a great gaming experience.

Best regards,
rennsemmel81

notes.title: Spitfire - Moonpies Mission Demo Update 1.01
notes.notes:
Spitfire - Moonpie’s Mission Demo 1.01 Update

First of all, a big thank you for playing and testing my demo so enthusiastically! :)

Since creating the page and presenting the demo for the game, I've received some initial change requests and improvement suggestions from the growing community. Now, I want to finish the game as well as possible for you, making sure to address the most important points.

Here’s a quick overview of the changes I’ve already made:

- The design of the options menu has been made more user-friendly.
- A fullscreen mode has been integrated (can be toggled in the options menu).
- An exit button has been added to the title screen.
- When unlocking the second weapon, an info screen appears explaining how to switch weapons.
- A coin symbol has been added to indicate the cost of ammunition for weapons and shields.
- The HUD now shows which weapon is equipped and what type of ammunition it’s firing.

Bugs:
The wild boar in the second section should no longer harm the player when teleporting (fixed).
